messages:
maria.chen: Heads-up: we're making changes to audit export and storage for customer-facing audit logs. Need input on schema, KMS key design, and RBAC restrictions. TL;DR: plan to add chain-proof fields and separate archive key. Thoughts?

/devin.kim: :+1: sounds good. Quick Q: do you mean a hash chain (prev_hash -> event_hash) or a Merkle tree per-export?

/maria.chen: prev_hash chaining per-event to make sequential tamper-evident. Merkle for bulk verification on downloads. We'll include both: event.prev_hash and export.merkle_root.

/samir.patel: Agree. Also need new fields in schema: event_hash, prev_hash, export_id, signer_kid, signature, merkle_index. Keep backward compatible (nullable fields).

/security-bot: Automated check: any new PII fields must be reviewed. Run data classification on the sample events and attach the report.

/maria.chen: Good call. We'll strip user IPs from exported audit events unless customer requests full trace. Also propose RBAC change: only roles "security_engineer" and "compliance_admin" can trigger exports. DevEx: add gating in console and API.

/devin.kim: KMS question: should archive use customer-managed key (CMK) by default? We could have internal archival key with rotation and a customer option for BYOK.

/ops-oncall: Ops prefers dedicated archive key per-tenant (BYOK) to avoid cross-tenant blast radius. However that increases key management complexity for small tenants. Suggest default internal key + opt-in BYOK.

/maria.chen: Decision proposal: default internal 'redwood-archive' KMS with HSM-backed rotation; provide BYOK per-requested enterprise customers. We'll log key usage in audit and include signer_kid in exports.

/samir.patel: Retention tiers: 90d / 1yr / 7yr. For WORM, use immutable S3 object-lock with legal hold + replication to cold archive. Exported manifest signed and stored in WORM. Also include export provenance: signer_kid, signing_key_fingerprint, kms_key_id.

/devin.kim: Implementation note: to prove immutability, include signed manifest.json with merkle_root, export_id, timestamp, and signature. Store manifest in WORM and return manifest.s3_url to customer.

/maria.chen: Action items: devin to prototype manifest signer and KMS integration (ETA 1w); samir to add schema PR; ops-oncall to write runbook for key provisioning. I'll open RFC.

/security-bot: Automated note: Created RFC draft at https://rwd/secure/rfcs/1234. Assign reviewers: @devin.kim @samir.patel @ops-oncall.

/devin.kim: I'll pick this up. One more: add periodic integrity job verifying stored manifests and chain hashes, alert on mismatch. Should run daily for high-risk tenants.

/maria.chen: Yes, schedule daily for critical tenants, weekly for default. Thanks everyone, I'll file the RFC and link the PRs here. :thumbsup:
